key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7272
name: visit_cell_and_neighbours
description: Recursively visits a cell record: when a count word is set and the record type byte is 1 it copies the record into a temporary, adjusts its coordinates and recurses on it. It then looks up two neighbouring cells in per-cell tables, recurses on each that is flagged, and clears the flag byte of the primary cell.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:72DA
name: visit_cell_record_direct
description: Builds a cell record from the first two words of its input with fixed type 3, then recurses on the cell and its flagged neighbours using the same table lookups. A second neighbour is visited only when the count word is nonzero and the type byte is 6.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7604
name: lookup_cell_flag_bit
description: Converts a packed coordinate word into a table index by masking and shifting, then calls the cell routine with the stored flag byte masked to bit 6. It is called for a single cell and returns nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7660
name: store_cell_state_entry
description: Chooses a state value from the first argument's type word and the coordinate bits, then packs it with the type and writes it, with a companion byte and a value, into per-cell tables. It then calls a routine taken from a pointer table indexed by the coordinate.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:774E
name: clear_buffer_and_init_state
description: Zeroes a 512-entry long-word buffer, calls a library routine to read a 32-bit value, and stores it in a global. It then chooses a 16-bit value based on a global flag, updates a counter, and calls two further routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:77D2
name: check_flag_and_store
description: If the zero flag is set, it calls routines and returns the result shifted right by one. Otherwise it stores the returned value and an extra register value into a global table at an index taken from a register.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:77FC
name: advance_counter_when_equal
description: Returns unchanged unless bit 0 of the passed word is set and the two address registers are equal. In that case it adds their difference to a counter in the global block and calls a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:783E
name: assemble_byte_bit_by_bit
description: Runs eight iterations that shift an accumulator left, call a routine on each step, and set the low bit when the shifted value was nonzero. The result is one assembled byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7852
name: build_huffman_decode_table
description: Reads 256 pairs of code length and value words from a source table. It fills a local table with direct entries for codes up to nine bits and second-level entries for longer codes, then copies the result into the global decode table.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7922
name: decode_huffman_bytes_into_buffer
description: Reads bits from a shared bit window and decodes Huffman symbols up to a requested count, writing each decoded byte to an output pointer. Codes longer than the direct table are resolved by searching the second-level entries.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7A3A
name: stub_empty_return
description: The routine contains only a return and performs no operations.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7A4C
name: read_word_advancing_counter
description: When the passed count is nonzero it returns a packed value built from a word read through an address register. Otherwise it adds a fixed increment to a counter, calls a routine, and reads the word through a stored pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7A94
name: decode_huffman_bytes_with_padding
description: Decodes Huffman symbols from a shared bit window into an output buffer until the count is reached. If the count is odd it writes a zero pad byte at the end, and it saves its state for the next call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7BD8
name: fetch_bit_window_word
description: Clears a flag, calls a routine, then reads the next byte, or a word when the stream pointer is odd, and advances the counter. It stores the value with a shift mask taken from the parameter.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7C1A
name: advance_counter_by_pointer_gap
description: Computes the distance between two stored pointers, adds a fixed offset, subtracts the parameter, and adds the result to a counter. It then calls a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7C34
name: clear_block_and_reset_state
description: Calls a library routine to clear a block in the global data area, calls three initialisation routines, and sets a status word to zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7C5A
name: dispatch_by_state_word
description: Calls a library routine, then branches on a state word: value 0 and value 1 each call a routine, and larger values call a third routine only for the value 2. It returns the result of the chosen routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7C8C
name: init_flags_and_setup_routines
description: Calls two routines, sets two flag words to 1, and calls library routines. When a stored word is zero it calls two more routines, then calls a final routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7CCE
name: reset_history_and_seed
description: Reverses the history table of eight-byte entries, sets its index to -1, and seeds the first entry and a mirror entry from two stored long words.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7D3C
name: pop_history_and_seed
description: Decrements the history index, shifts the remaining entries down by one, and writes two stored long words into the top entry.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7D96
name: init_round_state_fields
description: Zeroes several state words and a flag, sets a counter to 23 and a limit to 200 when a flag byte is set. It calls two routines and a library routine, then sets a side value from a table lookup.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7E28
name: run_eight_step_update_cycle
description: Calls four routines per iteration for eight iterations, then calls one more routine. It finally clears a counter word and sets a second word to 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7EBA
name: reset_index_and_copy_pair
description: Sets an index word to -1 and copies two stored long words from globals into a second saved block.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7ED4
name: store_two_bytes_in_table
description: Writes the high and low bytes of the first argument into a table entry selected by the second argument, scaled by four.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7F00
name: poll_until_event_ready
description: Clears two words, then calls a routine to read a value. When the value is nonzero it stores a byte, sets a flag, and loops calling routines until a stored word is nonzero or a library check returns a nonzero result, which it passes on.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7F96
name: dispatch_on_state_code
description: Branches on the low byte of a state word to one of nine cases, each calling library and internal routines. Case values 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 11, 14, 15 and 18 each set or clear state words and call internal routines; any other value clears the state word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7FAC
name: clear_state_after_call
description: Calls a routine, then a library routine, clears a state word, and calls a final routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:81DC
name: loop_dispatch_until_done
description: Repeats a three-way dispatch on an index word until the mode flag leaves the value 2 or the stored step flag is no longer 1. It clears the mode flag and returns the last routine result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:8230
name: update_turn_flags_and_index
description: Resets a counter and a flag, then branches on two stored values. It sets a turn-state flag, calls a library routine, and sets an index word to 1 before calling a final routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:82DE
name: check_resign_conditions_message
description: Copies stored position words, then either processes a pending move entry or checks limits for a side. When the limits are reached it displays a resignation message, either the Blue resigns or the Red resigns text, chosen by a side value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:84C4
name: stub_empty_return
description: The routine contains only a return and performs no operations.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:84CC
name: stub_empty_return
description: The routine contains only a return and performs no operations.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:84D4
name: select_table_index_and_reset
description: Reads a library value and finds the first table index whose byte is larger than its low four bits. It calls a routine that many times, stores a six-bit count, copies two stored long words into a saved slot, clears three words, and calls a library routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:857E
name: flush_pending_history_entries
description: Sets a flag and calls a library routine. When a count is below a limit, it calls routines on the pending history entries, updates the limit, and clears the entry counter.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:865A
name: scan_entries_for_matching_index
description: Increments a counter and, if the index is past the current entry, flags it. Otherwise it searches stored entries for a six-bit index matching a target value and calls routines on the matching entry and its neighbour.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:874A
name: read_balanced_bit_run
description: If the first value is below 128 it reads pairs of values, adjusting a balance count for bit 6 and for values of 128 or more, until the balance returns to zero. It then reads one more value and returns either that value or the result of another routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:87BA
name: wait_until_bit_six_set
description: Repeatedly reads a value and calls a routine until bit 6 of the value is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:87DA
name: unwind_balanced_bit_run
description: Decrements a counter and reads values in a loop, tracking values of 128 or more and values with bit 6 set until the balance returns to zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:8818
name: stub_empty_return
description: The routine contains only a return and performs no operations.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:8820
name: store_library_result_pair
description: Calls a library routine with a zero argument and stores its 32-bit result into two adjacent words.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:8838
name: record_library_time_delta
description: Calls a library routine with a zero argument and stores its 32-bit result. It also stores the difference between that result and a previously saved value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:8858
name: accumulate_delta_into_slot
description: Calls a routine, then adds the stored time difference into a long-word slot selected by the low word of the argument, scaled by four.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:8876
name: forward_two_arguments
description: Passes its two arguments unchanged to another routine and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:888E
name: push_pair_to_history_slot
description: Writes a saved pair of long words into the history slot selected by the index, copies the same pair into two globals, and passes the slot values to another routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:88DE
name: advance_index_and_swap_pair
description: Increments an index and a counter, calls a routine with two arguments, then swaps two stored 16-bit words.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:8916
name: retreat_index_and_swap_pair
description: Swaps the same two stored 16-bit words back, calls a routine with two arguments, and decrements the index and counter.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:8950
name: read_indexed_byte_between_calls
description: Calls a routine with two arguments, reads a byte from a table at the index held in a stored word, then calls the same routine again and returns that byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:89AC
name: dispatch_command_code_handler
description: Dispatches a command word on its low byte to switch cases 3, 7 through 10, 12, 13, 16 and 17, which update state and flag words and call routines. Commands with a nonzero high nibble only clear the state word, and the routine ends by returning the result of a further call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:8B1E
name: stub_empty_return
description: The routine contains only a return and performs no operations.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:8B26
name: call_global_function_pointer
description: Invokes a function pointer stored at a fixed offset in the global data block.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:8CCA
name: set_timer_from_state_code
description: Stores the high byte of a command word as the state value. A zero state sets a timer to 6, state 10 calls two pointer routines and either keeps the previous state or stores the result as the timer, and other states set a timer from a power of two based on the state minus one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:8CEE
name: resume_state_timer_entry
description: When the state is 10 it calls two pointer routines and either restores a saved state word or stores the result as the timer. Otherwise it sets the timer from the state and clears two counters.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:8D0E
name: copy_saved_state_word
description: Copies a state word from the stack entry two bytes below the current frame into the state variable.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:8D16
name: set_timer_and_clear_counters
description: Sets a timer from the current state as a power of two and clears two long-word counters.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:8D32
name: reset_timer_with_minimum
description: Sets a flag word to 1, clears another, and copies the timer into a counter that is raised to at least 3.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:8D5C
name: copy_byte_array
description: Copies a sequence of bytes from a source pointer to a destination pointer for the given count.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:8D84
name: compare_byte_strings
description: Compares bytes from two pointers for the given count. It returns 0 when all compared bytes match, and otherwise the difference between the first mismatching pair.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:8DC4
name: refresh_display_marker_flags
description: Blanks the character cells of several text lists and sets a series of visibility flags from the state and flag words. It then writes plus-sign markers at the positions chosen by those words.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:8F9E
name: mark_matching_entries_in_bitmap
description: Clears a bitmap region with a library call and increments a depth counter. It loops over stored entries and, for each entry matching a stored key that passes a routine's test, sets the matching bit in the bitmap.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:901C
name: search_for_matching_pair
description: Clears a result flag and increments an index, then loops reading a stored pair. It returns the result flag when the pair matches the target, or after pushing a saved pair into a history slot when the entry flag is clear.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:9052
name: push_pending_entry_to_history
description: Loops while a pending pair differs from the saved pair, returning a flag byte at the end. It then writes a saved pair into the history slot selected by the index and decrements the index.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:9082
name: pack_cell_table_into_buffer
description: Writes a leading byte from a stored value, then packs pairs of entries from a 128-entry table into the output buffer, combining each entry's two fields into one byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:9132
name: unpack_cell_table_from_buffer
description: Reads a leading byte into a state word and sets a second word to that value XOR 1. It then calls routines in a loop to fill each entry of a 128-entry table and finishes with two library calls.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:91F0
name: select_board_validation_message
description: Counts pieces for each side on a 120-cell table. Depending on the counts and king positions it returns one of several referenced message pointers, including Red has too many pieces, or a null pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:9290
name: check_blue_piece_limit_message
description: Applies the piece-count limit check for Blue and returns the referenced pointer for Blue has too many pieces, or a null pointer when the check does not apply.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:92A0
name: check_red_king_count_message
description: Checks the king counts for both sides and a king position, then returns the referenced pointer for Red has too many Kings or a null pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:92B0
name: check_blue_king_count_message
description: Checks the king counts for both sides and a king position, then returns the referenced pointer for Blue has too many Kings or a null pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:92C0
name: check_red_king_needed_message
description: Returns the referenced pointer for Red needs a King when Red's king count is below one and the second side's king is present; otherwise it returns a null pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:92D0
name: check_blue_king_needed_message
description: Returns the referenced pointer for Blue needs a King when Blue's king count is below one, otherwise a null pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:92E0
name: check_kings_adjacent_message
description: Searches the eight neighbour offsets of one stored position for the other position. It returns the referenced pointer for Kings are adjacent on a match, and otherwise calls a routine and returns a null pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:931C
name: check_blue_in_check_message
description: Searches the eight neighbour offsets of a stored position and returns the referenced pointer for Blue is in Check when a match is found or a routine succeeds. Otherwise it returns a null pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:935E
name: return_red_check_message
description: Returns the referenced pointer for the text Red is in Check.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:9368
name: return_constant_zero
description: Returns the value zero and performs no other operations.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:942E
name: clear_counter_after_two_calls
description: Calls two routines in sequence, then clears a counter word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:9442
name: return_minimum_of_halves
description: Compares the low and high 16-bit halves of its argument and returns the smaller value.
